# eBay

> > eBay is a global e-commerce marketplace enabling users to buy and sell goods through auctions and fixed-price listings.

eBay provides comprehensive account management and authentication services, supporting multiple sign-in methods including Google, Apple, and Facebook. The platform serves millions of buyers and sellers worldwide with personalized account features.

## Key Topics

- eBay marketplace
- Account registration
- Personal accounts
- User authentication
- Google sign-in
- Apple sign-in
- Facebook sign-in
- Account creation
- User signup
- E-commerce platform
- Buyer accounts
- Seller accounts

## Account Management

- [Register: Create a personal eBay account](https://reg.ebay.com/pa/crte?ru=https://www.ebay.com/): Personal account registration page with Google, Apple, Facebook sign-in
